summary: Ansible's search path grows during a run; it loads modules, module_utils and plugins first from directories next to the command-line playbook, then next to statically imported playbooks, then from referenced role directories.
questions: In what order does Ansible look for custom modules and plugins?
Do directories next to an imported playbook get added to the search path?
Once a role runs, do its plugin directories stay in scope?

answer_card.title: Ansible search path (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
The search path grows as playbooks and roles are found and stays in scope for the run. Order:
1. Dirs next to the CLI playbook: `/path/to/modules`, `module_utils`, `plugins`
2. Dirs next to statically imported playbooks (`import_playbook`)
3. Role subdirectories: `roles/myrole/modules`, `module_utils`, `plugins`
4. (continued) configured paths, then built-ins
